patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Webflow share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Sellfy and Webflow share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than Webflow's shape. Choose Webflow only if your buying job matches “Design-led website platform with Ecommerce — Standard $29/mo (500 items, 2% fee), Plus $74” rather than Sellfy's shape. Workflow advantage: Sellfy leans digital-business-marketplace; Webflow leans website-builder-commerce. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Webflow share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce.; Webflow is Design-led website platform with Ecommerce — Standard $29/mo (500 items, 2% fee), Plus $74 highlighted (5,000 items, 0% fee), Advanced $212 .
- Company-size focus: Sellfy (micro, small-business) vs Webflow (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Sellfy-leaning digital-business-marketplace vs Webflow-leaning website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: Sellfy — none listed; Webflow — Ecommerce requires a Site plan in addition to the Ecommerce plan — model combined TCO, not the $29 floor alone.

Limitations — Sellfy: —; Webflow: Ecommerce requires a Site plan in addition to the Ecommerce plan — model combined TCO, not the $29 floor alone; Catalog caps (500 / 5,000 / 15,000 items) and Standard’s 2% transaction fee trail Shopify-class commerce OS depth.

Poor-fit cases: Webflow is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Ecommerce requires a Site plan in addition to the Ecommerce plan — model combined TCO, not the $29 floor alone · Avoid Sellfy if you actually need Webflow's motion (Design-led website platform with Ecommerce — Standard $29/mo (500 items, 2% fee)) · Avoid Webflow if you actually need Sellfy's motion (Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner i)
